title: Complete security check
intro_desc: The security check sets up cross-signing keys for your account. Afterwards your verified devices can recognise each other, and the message lock will show as verified.
password_notice: The server requires a second confirmation, so your current account password is needed.
success_desc: Security check complete — cross-signing keys are set up.
needs_security_key: Your cross-signing private keys are not stored in your security key yet. They cannot be recovered after switching devices or clearing data — set it up now.
store_keys_success: Cross-signing keys stored in your security key
store_keys_failed: Failed to store keys in your security key
